prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in Chengdu, I remember just wandering around and stumbling into all these little spots—felt like the whole city was one big attraction map.
Then on that other trip, Shanghai was a totally different vibe—my friend kept talking about the rental options there like it was a whole hobby.
Oh, and Luo Fei had already sorted tickets for Kuanzhai Alley for 2025-03-14—two of us went together.
I remember the entry time was the afternoon, and the ticket was under Luo Fei’s name—everything was set before we even arrived.
And Sophia Garcia had done a car rental in Shanghai too—a BMW 5 Series starting 2025-03-04 for 7 days, which sounded pretty comfy for getting around.
